articles.description: Nvidia's quarterly earnings call on Tuesday was its first with CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress at the helm alongside the company's first board chair, Harvey C. Jones. articles.description: Key TakeawaysBrad Gerstner’s Altimeter Capital sold all of its Applied Materials, KLA and Qualcomm shares in the third quarter, and in the same quarter it added to Meta Platforms and opened a position in Tesla. articles.title: China’s Automotive Surge in Brazil Is Reshaping the Patent Landscape
articles.description: Imports of Chinese electric and hybrid vehicles are transforming Brazil’s automotive market. At the same time, data from the Brazilian Patent and Trademark Office (BPTO) show Chinese companies expanding their patent presence. Together, these trends suggest a new phase of competition in which electrification, software and artificial intelligence (AI) may matter as much as manufacturing scale and dealer networks.
